description: Value of converting to a Roth now, with the tax paid out of the converted amount, versus leaving the money in a traditional account taxed at the retirement rate, after growth. Use when the user weighs converting traditional retirement money to a Roth and paying the tax now. For choosing future contributions use calculate_roth_vs_traditional. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive roth conversion calculator.

conversion_amount.description: Amount considered for conversion in USD.

current_tax_rate_pct.description: Tax rate percent if converting now.

retirement_tax_rate_pct.description: Expected tax rate percent in retirement.
